Pelican’s 18-hole golf course, designed with inspiration from Donald Ross’ original layout, can play to a par 70, stretches to 7,000 yards, and features lush greenery, undulating terrain, and crushed quartz sand.
For those who plan ahead, be aware that Pelican's front tees will allow you to play an easier 1171 yard golf course while the back tees stretch the course to 1777 yards of fun.

Pelican Pointe Golf and Country Club is located in Venice, Florida, 15 miles south of Sarasota, near Laurel, Nokomis, North Port, Englewood. The club includes 27 championship golf holes, tennis courts, swimming pool, fitness center, banquet facilities, weddings, PGA LPGA golf professionals.
